title: The Collected Short Stories

vibeProfile.oneLine: The clever, wide-ranging short stories of Satyajit Ray.

summary: A collection of the short stories of Satyajit Ray, the legendary filmmaker who was also a gifted and hugely popular writer in Bengali. Ranging from eerie and supernatural tales to twist-in-the-tail mysteries and science fiction, his stories are ingenious, witty and beautifully crafted for readers of all ages. Beyond the cinema, Ray built a whole literary world, and this gathering shows the same imagination and precision that made him one of the great storytellers of modern India.
whyReadIt: The ingenious, witty short stories of the legendary Satyajit Ray, filmmaker and beloved Bengali writer. Craft and imagination.

funFacts.text: Ray also created the beloved boy scientist Professor Shonku and the detective Feluda.
